propositions: A vendored Dockerfile builds a real Jira 8.17.1 Server instance from the pinned addono base digest with mandatory flags -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout to prevent silent startup failures.

The harness composes on loopback 127.0.0.1:2990 with tty/stdin_open enabled, persistent Maven cache volume, and platform: linux/amd64 to support testing on native x86_64 CI runners where cold startup takes 3-8 minutes.

Personal Access Token authentication via Bearer tokens works end-to-end: tokens are minted programmatically via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens with admin credentials and authenticate REST v2 requests, proving DC's auth mode is exercised rather than assumed.
The harness is verified only on native amd64 runners; arm64 emulation extends startup beyond 25 minutes and hits Cargo's deploy ceiling, making acceptance evidence impossible on non-x86_64 hardware.

Test suite teardown polls direct issue endpoints (/rest/api/2/issue/{key}) for 404 responses without consulting the search index, preventing stale or lagging search results from masking incomplete deletions.

A new job in external-integration.yml builds the harness, waits for readiness (20-minute budget, 5-second cadence), runs tests only under REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1, and tears down on all outcomes; the pre-existing external job gains --ignore=tests/external/live_jira_dc to preserve its canary's ability to detect all-skip conditions.
